306. Telegram From
the Department of State
to
the Embassy in Pakistan
1
Washington
,
December 14, 1971,
                            2136Z
.
224704. If and when Bangla Desh and or Indian forces occupy Dacca, you should
                        not take any initiative to establish or encourage contact with them beyond
                        that which may be required in emergency situations to protect American lives
                        or to otherwise assure safety of your mission.
Rogers
